entries.title: fix(hare): make the reasoning hop answer, and stop losing the answer

findings.issue: The fence regex uses `\\` (literal backslash) instead of triple backticks. The fence path is dead code; the test passes only because `json_objects` covers the same case. A future maintainer who trusts the fence path will be surprised.

`test_hare_once_accepts_an_ordered_hop_override` inspects `co_varnames` rather than calling the function with a `hop_override` and asserting the provider list is honoured. It will pass even if the parameter is ignored at runtime.

Setting `os.environ["GITHUB_EVENT_NAME"]` mutates the process globally. If any imported module reads that variable at import time or in a later call, it will see the spoofed value. A `contextlib` or explicit parameter would be safer, but the current scope (single script, single call) makes the risk low.
